column2: Starting XI challenges (age, squad, nationality): every league match counts on its own, with the eleven you start it with (substitutes do not count). A challenge is met when it held in more than half of your league matches of the season, and at least 10 were played.

Ages are on the match day. Homegrown: joined the club at 18 or younger. Youth player: homegrown and 21 or younger. International: has played for his country. Foreign and own country go by the country of your club's league.
Keeper + 4 defenders all 28+: your keeper and every defender you start (sweeper, D, wing back), at least four defenders.
Tactics challenges: the formation of your active tactic in every league match. Defenders are SW, D and WB; midfielders DM, M and AMC; attackers F and ST; attacking wingers AML and AMR.

Play with (a sweeper, three attackers, five defenders, five midfielders, one defender): every league match, at least 10. Without wing backs, without attacking wingers and Always 4-4-2 fail at the first league match that breaks them. Without a striker: 15 league matches.
Transfers: a season's deals run from the end of May to the end of May, as the game dates them. Winter is December to February for every country, whatever its own transfer window.
Release five players: players let go to no club, from the start of the season up to the end of February. A contract running out at the end of a season does not count.
